formal_title: Empirical Noncommutative Transport, Repair↔Loss Order-Reversal Intervention, Transformation-Monoid Identification, Property-Indexed Carrier Replication, Restricted Observation-Functor Construction, Surface-Selection↔Path-Transport Two-Level Composition, Law-Family Decomposition Uniqueness & Macro-Structure Reconstruction

properties_frozen_before_fresh_outcome: {D,R} is a left-zero semigroup under composition
M_CR is a three-element monoid consisting of identity plus two constants
M_CR is a proper submonoid of the full transformation monoid T_2

theorem_targets.statement: Every word over {I,D,R} evaluates to I if it contains no D/R; otherwise it equals the leftmost non-identity generator under the chosen composition notation, equivalently the last-applied constant in execution order.
No one-state action can represent M_CR faithfully; a two-state action is faithful and therefore minimal.
The quotient that identifies all paths containing D as failure is not a congruence once R is admitted.
An observation map Q can erase noncommutativity only if Q∘D=Q∘R on the reachable state set; otherwise order remains observable.
For independent properties o1,o2, boundary transport acts on a product state S_o1×S_o2; property-independent scalar edge labels are faithful only under a diagonal-action restriction.

representation_program.transport: Functor-like assignment of path morphisms to transformations T_p^o
representation_program.observation: Restricted quotient Q_o from arrived property state to decision-visible state
representation_program.anti_triviality: Q_o and D_loc may not be arbitrary mechanism-local lookup tables.

empirical_noncommutativity.strong_witness_requirement: A fresh mechanism must expose two source-defined operations L(loss/filter/prune/drop) and R(repair/alias/convert/reconstitute) applicable to materially matched input such that execution order L→R and R→L yields different client-observable outcomes.

property_indexed_replication.requirement: A second mechanistically distinct source must show the same boundary/operation transports one property but not another, without posthoc property naming.
property_indexed_replication.strong_pass: Two properties share the same physical boundary while requiring distinct transport maps.
property_indexed_replication.support_only: Different classes/routes use different handlers but no shared boundary comparison.

restricted_bridge.goal: Connect PATH_CARRIER_TRANSPORT to SURFACE_SELECTION without arbitrary mechanism-local maps.

allowed_forms: choose action from arrived visible state plus existing frozen X,G,E using a depth-1 or depth-2 decision grammar

restricted_bridge.bridge_success: A single frozen Q form and D_loc grammar maps at least one exact surface-selection family and at least two exact path-transport families without mechanism ID and with held-out prediction.
restricted_bridge.bridge_failure: Rust requires a mechanism-specific observation/action clause unavailable to carrier families.

decomposition_uniqueness.criterion: Prefer the coarsest partition that preserves held-out predictive distinctions under the restricted grammar; ties remain non-unique.

implementation.formalization: Lean optional only if an existing pinned workflow/toolchain is available; otherwise proof note + finite exhaustive checker.
